name: Falling Text
description: Text block whose words or letters drop under physics, pile up on the container floor, bounce, and can be dragged or pushed by the cursor, then optionally spring back into place.
contents: Single text block split into words or letters, each a physics piece
Optional highlighted words with accent color
Plain text or rounded tile look for each piece
behavior: Pieces fall with Matter.js gravity and collide with the container walls and each other
Fall starts automatically, on hover, on click, or when scrolled into view, depending on trigger
Pieces are released one by one in random, center-out, or reading order, or all together
Pieces can be grabbed and thrown with the pointer, and moving the cursor fast pushes nearby pieces
After restoreDelay seconds of calm, pieces spring back to their original positions and the effect re-arms
Simulation pauses while off screen and does nothing with reduced motion enabled
editableByProps: Text, highlighted words, highlight class and accent color
Split into words or letters, text or tile look, dark or light tile theme
Trigger, fall order, stagger, gravity, bounciness, scatter
Dragging, drag stiffness, cursor push strength, auto restore delay
Font size, background color, wireframe outlines, className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tile colors or add another theme
Change the spring-back duration or delay
Change piece friction, density or air drag
needsCodeEdit.where: Matter.Bodies.rectangle options inside the fall function

fixed: Container fills its parent (h-full w-full) with overflow hidden, so the parent must have a set height
Pieces stay inside the container, which acts as a closed box with floor, walls and ceiling
Text is centered and uses balanced wrapping
Trigger changes remount the effect; with auto, it runs once on mount after fonts load, other triggers re-arm after restore
Without restoreDelay the pieces stay fallen until the component remounts
Reduced motion users see the static text and no effect
Click trigger and dragging use pointer events, touch drag disables scrolling on pieces while falling

options.look: Plain text pieces with only highlighted words colored in the accent color
options.useWhen: A headline or 404 message that should read as normal typography until it collapses

options.look: Each word or letter is a rounded keycap-like tile with soft shadow, highlighted ones filled with accent color
options.useWhen: A playful hero or error page where the falling pieces should feel like physical blocks
